newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Men set beggar on fire in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Men set beggar on fire in Brazil.

text.p: Two men set a beggar on fire in the southeastern Brazilian city of Vitoria, claiming he owed them money, police said on Tuesday.
Jorge Luiz Fontes, 29, was attacked in the street Monday night and was taken to a hospital with burns on 80 percent of his body. His life was in danger, a police spokesman said.
The attack appeared similar to one a month ago in which five teenagers killed a native Brazilian Indian by setting him ablaze while he was sleeping at a bus stop in Brasilia.
Police said they had their doubts about the claim by one of Fontes' alleged assailants, who was arrested, that he and his partner, who escaped, attacked Fontes because of his debts.
"He says they burned the beggar because he owed them money, but it's possible that the motive was frivolous," the spokesman said.
